_note: Tool catalog for the agent. Exact JSON schemas are generated from the zod schemas in apps/server/src/agent/tools/*.ts. Every input also has a required 'rationale': {title: string<=60, why: string<=160}. Types refer to types/shared.ts.

tools.name: change_mode
tools.description: Switch to explore (read-only investigation and answers) or build (create and change things through the draft).

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user 1-3 short questions, with choices when possible. Pauses until they answer.

input.questions: { id: string; text: string; choices?: string[]; allowFreeText: boolean }[] (1-3)

tools.name: set_plan
tools.description: Create or update the plan shown to the user, in plain language.

tools.name: hide_items
tools.description: Hide finished tool results from your context to save space. A one-line summary is kept.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the project's datasets with current version, row count and columns.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Columns (name, type, nullable, sample values) and parse errors of a dataset version.

tools.name: preview_dataset
tools.description: First rows of a dataset (max 50).

tools.name: profile_columns
tools.description: Profile columns: row count, nulls, distinct count, uniqueness, top values, min/max. Optionally compute how many values of one column match another dataset's column (for links).

input.matchAgainst: { datasetId: string; column: string; fromColumn: string } | undefined

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Read the published or draft workspace (ontology, apps, automations): whole document, one entity, or just an inventory. Draft reads include the latest validation.

tools.name: search_ontology
tools.description: Search object types, properties, links and actions by name, description and aliases. Send several phrasings at once.

tools.name: query_objects
tools.description: Fetch objects from an object set with selected properties (max 50 per call).

tools.name: aggregate_objects
tools.description: Count / sum / average objects of a set, optionally grouped by properties.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: One object with all properties and its linked objects.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Read-only SQL (SELECT/WITH) over the ont schema (one view per object type, columns = properties in snake_case) and the data schema. Max 500 rows, 5 seconds.

tools.name: get_action_log
tools.description: Recent action runs (who, when, what changed, status).

tools.name: get_automation_events
tools.description: Recent firings of an automation and what its effects did.

tools.name: edit_draft
tools.description: Apply operations to the workspace draft (upsert object types, properties, links, actions, apps, automations; remove; set metadata). Returns the new revision and validation.

tools.name: validate_draft
tools.description: Validate the draft, including data checks (unique keys, link match rates). Errors block publishing.

tools.name: diff_draft
tools.description: What publishing the draft would add, change and remove.

tools.name: test_action
tools.description: Dry-run an action as defined in the draft against current objects. Nothing is written.

tools.name: discard_draft
tools.description: Reset the draft to the published version.

tools.name: publish_draft
tools.description: Publish the draft so users see it. Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: run_action
tools.description: Run a published action on real objects. Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: enable_automation
tools.description: Switch on a published automation. Only future matches fire. Requires approval.

tools.name: disable_automation
tools.description: Switch off an automation. Requires approval.

tools.name: suggest_metadata
tools.description: Record up to 3 suggestions to improve descriptions or aliases, each with a rationale.

input.suggestions: { target: { kind: 'objectType'|'property'|'linkType'|'actionType'; apiName: string; objectType?: string }; field: 'description'|'displayName'|'aliases'; value: string | string[]; rationale: string }[] (<= 3)
